en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 remains in force as Saudel tracks across northern South China Sea
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the signal will stay until at least noon; Tropical Depression Saudel was about 400 kilometres south-southwest of the territory at 1am.
body: The Standby Signal No. 1 remained in force early on Tuesday as Tropical Depression Saudel continued to move across the northern part of the South China Sea.

According to the Hong Kong Observatory, at 1am the system was centred near 19.1 degrees north, 112.4 degrees east, about 400 kilometres south-southwest of Hong Kong, and was forecast to move east or east-northeast at about 22 kilometres per hour.

The Observatory said the signal would remain in force until at least noon on Tuesday. Under the combined influence of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, local winds were expected to strengthen later on Tuesday and Wednesday as the system edged closer to the coast of eastern Guangdong.

The Observatory will assess the need to issue the Strong Wind Signal No. 3 depending on Saudel’s intensity, the distance of its strong-wind area from the Pearl River Estuary and changes in local winds. Heavier showers were expected in parts of Hong Kong on Tuesday, the first day of the new school year.

zh.headline: 沙德爾橫過南海北部 一號戒備信號繼續生效
zh.dek: 天文台指信號至少維持至中午；熱帶低氣壓沙德爾凌晨1時位於本港西南偏南約400公里。
body: 一號戒備信號周二凌晨繼續生效，熱帶低氣壓沙德爾正橫過南海北部。
天文台表示，凌晨1時沙德爾集結在北緯19.1度、東經112.4度附近，即香港西南偏南約400公里，預料向東或東北偏東移動，時速約22公里。
天文台指，一號戒備信號至少維持至周二中午。受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，預計本港風力會在周二下午至周三逐步上升。
天文台會視乎沙德爾強度、其強風區與珠江口距離及本地風力變化，評估是否需要改發三號強風信號。預料周二本港部分地區雨勢較大，適逢新學年首日，市民出門前請留意最新天氣消息。
